claim_text: 01_schoels_analysis.py hardcoded 16 ENSDARG marker IDs of which 15 were WRONG vs the verified analysis/outputs/ensembl_symbol_map.json (only pax2a matched), under a misleading '# Ensembl release 111' comment with a non-existent symbol-fallback. The corruption had already materialized on disk: schoels_markers_canonical.csv shows pax2a correct (22.0% cells), wt1a (wrong ID ENSDARG00000054611) and hnf1bb (wrong ID) as FALSE POSITIVES (spurious 0.44%/1.5% expression attributed to an unrelated gene the wrong ID collided with), and pax8 + hnf1ba as FALSE NEGATIVES (found=False); the 11 segment markers used all-wrong IDs. Fix: replaced hardcoded IDs with runtime resolution from a new flat versioned verified-identifier store (DATA INAMOVIBLE v1, 32 records: 7 RAW anchors / 23 DERIVED / 2 positive-NOT_FOUND) via resolve_id.require(); all 16 markers now resolve and equal the verified map (16/16). A deterministic verify_output gate FAILS on the exact fabrication (wt1a==ENSDARG00000054611). Corrupted CSVs preserved under analysis/outputs/_superseded/ per ADR-0002.
human_gate_rationale: No compliance/budget/partner-relationship impact: this is a data-integrity correction whose verdict is deterministically re-derivable (resolver round-trip vs the verified map). Distinct from the 2026-05-31 LBPP record, which was gated on a confidentiality incident.
agent_invocation_status: Deterministic (Logic-LM-class) verification, not an LLM judgment. composite-auditor NOT invoked as a gate (justified below); the verdict is checkable by re-running resolve_id.
framework_applied: Logic-LM (Symbolic Verification) — per reasoning-frameworks-catalog.md §5: 'Problems where the answer must be provably correct, not just plausible' (Tier 1; 'produces results perfectly calibrated by construction'). Identifier resolution is a formalizable, deterministic check (does symbol S resolve to exactly ENSDARG X?), so Logic-LM is the correct citation — NOT the §Tier-2 anti-pattern present in the 2026-05-14 records. Per CLAUDE.md §5, framework_applied is self-report, not faithful introspection.
alternatives_considered: Hardcode the corrected IDs as literal constants with # verified tags (Form B) — rejected in favor of resolver-driven require() (Form A) so no ID is ever carried from memory and a future wrong ID raises loudly.
Leave the corrupted CSVs and overwrite on re-run — rejected per ADR-0002 (version preservation); moved to _superseded/ instead.

Treat phase2 outputs as also corrupted — rejected: 02_schoels_phase2.py rebuilds IDs via live Ensembl symbol-lookup against the verified map (independent), so it is likely sound; flagged at lower confidence (0.70) pending a re-run diff.
contradictory_evidence_cited: phase2 soundness is inferred, not re-run-confirmed (the GSE162031 data is gitignored, so the recovering re-run + diff is a pending verification step, logged in docs/findings/2026-06-10-schoels-phase1-id-corruption.md).
gap_flags: Re-run of 01_schoels_analysis.py to regenerate correct CSVs requires the scanpy env + GSE162031 data (gitignored) — not executed this cycle.
23 of 32 store records are DERIVED tier (raw response not retained); promoting them to RAW requires re-verification with §7.9 caching (NO-SPEND backlog).
verify_output v1 gates ENSDARG only; PMIDs/GEO/UniProt are flagged-not-verified offline (no literature store yet).
rater_id: self (deterministic re-derivation) — generator==rater is acceptable here ONLY because the check is symbolic and reproducible, not an LLM judgment.
expected_outcome_if_h1: Resolver round-trip: 16/16 schoels symbols resolve and equal ensembl_symbol_map.json; store builds (32 records); verify_output FAILS on wt1a==ENSDARG00000054611; grep '# verified:' present in the script.
expected_outcome_if_h0: Any of the 16 fails to resolve / mismatches the map, or the gate passes the known fabrication.
observed_outcome_detail: RESOLVED POSITIVE: build_verified_store wrote 32 records (7 RAW / 23 DERIVED / 2 NOT_FOUND); resolver round-trip 16/16 == ensembl_symbol_map.json; resolve('clcnkb') and resolve('nonsense') return NOT_FOUND (positive absence); verify_output FAILED on the wt1a fabrication and PASSED the correct ID. Prediction 0.95, outcome clean.

agents_invoked.reason: PR-09 (curator owns the resolve()/store interface) is deferred to a later cycle; in Cycle 1 the store + resolver are built directly. The curator should assume ownership when built.

This output is a deterministic, re-derivable data-integrity correction (resolver round-trip vs verified map), not a substrate-evidence audit verdict over reasoning. A composite-audit adds little over the symbolic re-check; recommend a periodic audit over the verified store itself once it accumulates non-DERIVED edits.
No ranked biological candidate / minimal-set generation in this output.
